gen-fs-oswald-gf-assistant: Confident and strong, Oswald packs its letters into tightly knit rows that mean business. But Assistant keeps its letter mouths open, so a page of body text moves along without any strain.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-asta-sans: Oswald packs tight, confident rows with a strong display voice. Asta Sans does the opposite job, with tubelike lines of constant weight and an e you never mistake for a blot.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-barlow: Oswald's most striking trait is its tightly knit, strong, confident rows. Barlow draws neon-tube strokes with its c tips pulled well apart, so body text can stay at a modest size.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-biz-udpgothic: BIZ UDPGothic spaces its letters lavishly, with a clear channel into each round. Oswald, meanwhile, is the one for confident, strong headings in tightly knit rows, while the sans body lets text breathe.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-bpmf-huninn: Oswald comes in confident, strong and tightly knit. Bpmf Huninn then reads with a single-weight outline feel and a wide channel into every bowl, so paragraphs flow along smoothly.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-bpmf-zihi-kai-std: Compact and confident, Oswald packs its rows tightly and earns its keep big and short. Bpmf Zihi Kai Std keeps its counters open to the outside, with only a restrained swell in curves.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-cairo: Strength lives in Oswald's tightly knit rows, hitting hard and looking confident. Cairo handles the quieter work, with a wide channel into every bowl that keeps lines of body text open and modern.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-cambay: Confident from the very first line, Oswald packs strong, tightly knit rows into every big heading. Cambay is the plain sans, its rounds gapping like a cracked bangle.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-chiron-hei-hk: Hard-hitting and dense: Oswald headings sit in tightly knit rows, confident and strong. And Chiron Hei HK steps in with a wide-open c like a bracelet pulled apart, keeping body text modern.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-encode-sans: Tightly knit rows of confident, strong letters give Oswald its weight at the top of the page. Encode Sans keeps c clearly different from o in the text below.
